def normalize_list(self, text, cache=None):
        """
        Get a canonical list representation of text, with words
        separated and reduced to their base forms.

        TODO: use the cache.
        """
        if cache is None:
            cache = {}
        if text in cache:
            return cache[text]
        text = self.normalize(text)
        if self.is_list(text):
            return text
        # Remove commas in the middle of words.
        text = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-zA-Z])(,)(?=[a-zA-Z])", "", text)
        # Remove commas before and after.
        text = re.sub(r"^,", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r",$", "", text)
        # Split on commas.
        text = re.split(r",", text)
        # Remove whitespace.
        text = [t.strip() for t in text]
        # Remove empty strings.
        text = [t for t in text if t]
        # Lowercase.
        text = [t.lower() for t in text]
        # Remove stopwords.
        text = [t for t in text if t not in self.stopwords]
        # Reduce to base form.
        text = [self.normalize(t) for t in text]
        # Remove duplicates.
        text = list(set(text))
        # Sort.
        text.sort()
        cache[text] = text
        return text
